title: Red Rock Canyon Self-Drive Jeep Rock Crawling Adventure
includes: Professional off-road guide with radio communication
Photos and videos taken during the tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Combine spectacular Red Rock Canyon sightseeing with the thrill of driving a purpose-built Jeep Rock Crawler. Enjoy the scenic loop before following an experienced guide onto the Rocky Gap Jeep Badge of Honor Trail. Your guide leads in a separate Jeep and provides real-time instructions by radio. Our modified Jeeps feature 40-inch tires, lockers, one-ton axles and roll bars for navigating rocks, boulders and steep switchbacks. Las Vegas Rock Crawlers has operated for more than 13 years, and our guides bring over 15 years of off-road experience. Photos and videos are included so you can enjoy the adventure and take the memories home.
